label: 1950s
title: Before the megaprojects
body: The 1950s planning record culminates in approval of the first Master Plan in 1958. Modern projects remain visible in the catalogue as pre-project entries, not as built geometry.

title: A foundation for growth
body: The 1963 East Coast pilot preceded the major reclamation programme starting in 1966. This snapshot separates early land-making from the much later MRT, DTSS and Tuas systems.

title: From experiments to systems
body: NEWater reaches demonstration scale while initial DTSS tunnel contracts are awarded. Existing rail and reclaimed districts coexist with projects still in development.

title: Operating, building, planning
body: Status as researched on 14 September 2026. Tuas operates while expanding; DTSS Phase 2 is not yet fully commissioned; Long Island preparatory works are still scheduled ahead.

title: A horizon, not a promise
body: Master Plan 2025 guides roughly 10–15 years; long-term planning and project targets extend further. This view distinguishes official ambitions from independent continuity assumptions. No invented 2050 as-built city.
